author: Sevoo
body:
Ok hi I'm Sevo. I'm looking for a competitive team c=.

Here's some info about me:

I've been playing Minecraft for the past 3 and a half years and joined Avicus around 3 years ago. I'm a tech guy and I make resource packs (good for official team packs!11!!) and I'm an overall cool guy. I have a microphone and I'm decently active (mostly on weekends). I have Skype (SevoMC) and TS if needed.

Stats:

- I'm 100 kills away from 50k kills and I have around a 1.4 KD (keep in mind I used to play with 20 fps and still kept a positive KD without camping). 

- I'm a 1900 ELO on BuildUHC

- I don't really play Kohi ranked, I play unranked and win most matches, but when I do play ranked I usually play archer. I'm pretty decent with a bow.

PvP:

- I'm decent in melee. I'm decent at w-tapping (not a g0d though) and I'm pretty good at hybrid block hitting. I'm a sky tank and can overall take on multiple people at a time, not necessarily killing them all but I can tank to distract. 

-In terms of secondaries (fishing rod, lava/fns, water) I'm decent with a rod and I can water drop.

-I have good ping which means I don't take much knock back (some people can knock me pretty far though) and can knock people off of sky bridges.

Bridging:

-Can ninja bridge

-Can jitter bridge (or breezily with jumping)

-Decent sky bridger (I practice in singleplayer once in a while and I'm pretty fast).

Experience: 

I see dem posts on 9gag saying how do you get experience if every job needs experience and that's the example I'm going to use today. The only competitive team I've been on is Proxy, which became very inactive as well as the god damn leader being banned on Avicus, so I decided to make this and see if some interesting offers comes up c=. I don't have much competitive experience (participated in a couple of scrims and never participated in a tourney,rip).

Can I stay active?:

-I'm Eastern Standard Time.

-My parents are strict when it comes to homework but if leaders advise me of a match 24 hours before I can organize my time so i can participate. Don't expect me to play in a scrim in a weekday if you advise me 30 minutes before the scrim, because I'm probably doing homework. 

-I'm active on Avicus Forums, Skype, and email. I'll give any teams I consider joining my email since that's where I'm most active.

Personality:

I'm going to be completely honest here. I'm 13 years old. I can be pretty toxic sometimes but I try my best to be nice, but my anger often gets the best of me. If you get to know me I'm a pretty cool guy. I used to be unintentionally cocky as well but I don't think I am anymore. I'm also shy and a bit socially anxious but only while I'm talking in my microphone, so if someone wants me to talk more in a competitive match just say the word and I'll try my best c;.

I'd also just like to say that I'm looking for competitive teams that are active and are willing to participate in tournaments. I've been in too many teams where everyone claims they're competitive but aren't (ex. Bxtches, Assassins, Kaldorei, etc, and btw basically carried all those teams).

Also can't play the game starting now until June the 22nd because I still have exams.
